segments.mn139:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn139:2.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn139:2.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn139:3.1: “Na kāmasukhamanuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogamanuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
segments.mn139:3.2: Ete kho, bhikkhave [ete kho (sī.), ete te (syā. kaṃ. pī.)], ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.mn139:3.4: ussādanañca ñatvā apasādanañca ñatvā nevussādeyya, na apasādeyya [nāpasādeyya (sī.)], dhammameva deseyya.
segments.mn139:3.7: Rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya, sammukhā na khīṇaṃ [nātikhīṇaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] bhaṇe.
segments.mn139:3.9: Janapadaniruttiṃ nābhiniveseyya, samaññaṃ nātidhāveyyāti – ayamuddeso araṇavibhaṅgassa.
segments.mn139:4.1: “‘Na kāmasukhamanuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogamanuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitan’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ;
segments.mn139:4.3: Yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho; micchāpaṭipadā.
segments.mn139:4.4: Yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyogo hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho; sammāpaṭipadā.
segments.mn139:4.5: Yo attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho; micchāpaṭipadā.
segments.mn139:4.6: Yo attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyogo dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho; sammāpaṭipadā.
segments.mn139:4.7: ‘Na kāmasukhamanuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitan’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:5.1: “‘Ete kho ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:5.3: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi.
segments.mn139:5.5: ‘Ete kho ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:6.2: ussādanañca ñatvā apasādanañca ñatvā nevussādeyya, na apasādeyya, dhammameva deseyyā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:7.1: Kathañca, bhikkhave, ussādanā ca hoti apasādanā ca, no ca dhammadesanā?
segments.mn139:7.2: ‘Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ [iti paraṃ (ka.)] ittheke apasādeti.
segments.mn139:7.4: “‘Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ ittheke ussādeti.
segments.mn139:7.6: “‘Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ ittheke apasādeti.
segments.mn139:7.8: “‘Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ ittheke ussādeti.
segments.mn139:7.10: “‘Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ ittheke apasādeti.
segments.mn139:7.12: “‘Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – iti vadaṃ ittheke ussādeti.
segments.mn139:7.14: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ussādanā ca hoti apasādanā ca, no ca dhammadesanā.
segments.mn139:8.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, nevussādanā hoti na apasādanā, dhammadesanā ca [dhammadesanāva (syā. kaṃ.)]?
segments.mn139:8.2: ‘Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.4: ‘Anuyogo ca kho, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:8.7: “‘Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.9: ‘Ananuyogo ca kho, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:8.12: “‘Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.14: ‘Anuyogo ca kho, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:8.17: “‘Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.19: ‘Ananuyogo ca kho, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:8.22: “‘Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.24: ‘Bhavasaṃyojane ca kho appahīne bhavopi appahīno hotī’ti – iti vadaṃ dhammameva deseti.
segments.mn139:8.26: “‘Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā’ti – na evamāha.
segments.mn139:8.28: ‘Bhavasaṃyojane ca kho pahīne bhavopi pahīno hotī’ti – iti vadaṃ dhammameva deseti.
segments.mn139:8.30: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, nevussādanā hoti na apasādanā, dhammadesanā ca.
segments.mn139:8.32: ussādanañca ñatvā apasādanañca ñatvā nevussādeyya, na apasādeyya, dhammameva deseyyā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:9.2: sukhavinicchayaṃ ñatvā ajjhattaṃ sukhamanuyuñjeyyā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:9.6: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, sotaviññeyyā saddā … ghānaviññeyyā gandhā … jivhāviññeyyā rasā … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā.
segments.mn139:9.12: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ.
segments.mn139:9.13: ‘Na āsevitabbaṃ, na bhāvetabbaṃ, na bahulīkātabbaṃ, bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā’ti – vadāmi.
segments.mn139:9.14: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn139:9.15: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn139:9.16: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn139:9.18: Idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ.
segments.mn139:9.19: ‘Āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ, na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā’ti – vadāmi.
segments.mn139:9.21: sukhavinicchayaṃ ñatvā ajjhattaṃ sukhamanuyuñjeyyā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:10.1: “‘Rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya, sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:10.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā rahovādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ [sampattaṃ (ka.)] taṃ rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya.
segments.mn139:10.5: Yampi jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ tassapi sikkheyya avacanāya.
segments.mn139:10.6: Yañca kho jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ tatra kālaññū assa tassa rahovādassa vacanāya.
segments.mn139:10.7: Tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ taṃ sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ na bhāseyya.
segments.mn139:10.8: Yampi jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ tassapi sikkheyya avacanāya.
segments.mn139:10.9: Yañca kho jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ tatra kālaññū assa tassa sammukhā khīṇavādassa vacanāya.
segments.mn139:10.10: ‘Rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya, sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:11.1: “‘Ataramānova bhāseyya no taramāno’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:11.3: Tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyopi kilamati, cittampi upahaññati [ūhaññati (sī.)], saropi upahaññati [ūhaññati (sī.)], kaṇṭhopi āturīyati, avisaṭṭhampi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.
segments.mn139:11.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, ataramānassa bhāsato kāyopi na kilamati, cittampi na upahaññati, saropi na upahaññati, kaṇṭhopi na āturīyati, visaṭṭhampi hoti viññeyyaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ.
segments.mn139:11.5: ‘Ataramānova bhāseyya, no taramāno’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:12.1: “‘Janapadaniruttiṃ nābhiniveseyya, samaññaṃ nātidhāveyyā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:12.3: Kathañca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca atisāro?
segments.mn139:12.4: Idha, bhikkhave, tadevekaccesu janapadesu ‘pātī’ti sañjānanti,‘pattan’ti sañjānanti,‘vittan’ti [viṭṭhanti (syā. kaṃ.)] sañjānanti,‘sarāvan’ti sañjānanti ‘dhāropan’ti [harosanti (syā. kaṃ.)] sañjānanti,‘poṇan’ti sañjānanti,‘pisīlavan’ti [pisīlanti (sī. pī.), pipilanti (syā. kaṃ.)] sañjānanti.
segments.mn139:12.5: Iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti tathā tathā thāmasā parāmāsā [parāmassa (sī.)] abhinivissa voharati –
segments.mn139:12.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca atisāro.
segments.mn139:12.8: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca anatisāro?
segments.mn139:12.9: Idha, bhikkhave, tadevekaccesu janapadesu ‘pātī’ti sañjānanti,‘pattan’ti sañjānanti,‘vittan’ti sañjānanti,‘sarāvan’ti sañjānanti,‘dhāropan’ti sañjānanti,‘poṇan’ti sañjānanti,‘pisīlavan’ti sañjānanti.
segments.mn139:12.10: Iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti ‘idaṃ kira me [idaṃ kira te ca (ka.)] āyasmanto sandhāya voharantī’ti tathā tathā voharati aparāmasaṃ.
segments.mn139:12.11: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso hoti, samaññāya ca anatisāro.
segments.mn139:12.12: ‘Janapadaniruttiṃ nābhiniveseyya samaññaṃ nātidhāveyyā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn139:13.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyogo hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.7: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yo attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.10: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyogo dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.13: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.16: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ ussādanā ca apasādanā ca no ca dhammadesanā, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.19: Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ nevussādanā ca na apasādanā ca dhammadesanā ca, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.22: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ pothujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.25: Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.28: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ rahovādo abhūto ataccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.31: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ rahovādo bhūto taccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.34: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ rahovādo bhūto taccho atthasaṃhito, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.37: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ sammukhā khīṇavādo abhūto ataccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.40: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ sammukhā khīṇavādo bhūto taccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.43: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ sammukhā khīṇavādo bhūto taccho atthasaṃhito, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.46: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.49: Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.52: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso samaññāya ca atisāro, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho;
segments.mn139:13.55: Tatra bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso samaññāya ca anatisāro, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho;
segments.mn139:14.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘saraṇañca dhammaṃ jānissāma, araṇañca dhammaṃ jānissāma;
segments.mn139:14.2: saraṇañca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇañca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjissāmā’ti evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
segments.mn139:14.3: Subhūti ca pana, bhikkhave, kulaputto araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno”ti.
segments.mn139:14.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Tattha nevussādeyya na apasādeyyāti gehasitavasena kañci puggalaṃ neva ukkhipeyya na avakkhipeyya.
Sammukhā na khīṇanti sammukhāpi khīṇaṃ ākiṇṇaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ vācaṃ na bhaṇeyya.
Ittheke apasādetīti evaṃ gehasitavasena ekacce puggale apasādeti.
Subhūtitthero kira imaṃ catukkaṃ nissāya etadagge ṭhapito.
Bhagavato hi dhammaṃ desentassa puggalānaṃ ussādanāapasādanā paññāyanti, tathā sāriputtattherādīnaṃ.

Subhūtittherassa pana dhammadesanāya “ayaṃ puggalo appaṭipannako anārādhako”ti vā,“ayaṃ sīlavā guṇavā lajjipesalo ācārasampanno”ti vā natthi, dhammadesanāya panassa “ayaṃ micchāpaṭipadā, ayaṃ sammāpaṭipadā” tveva paññāyati.
Tasmā bhagavā “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūtī”ti āha.
Kālaññū assāti asampatte ca atikkante ca kāle akathetvā “idāni vuccamānaṃ mahājano gaṇhissatī”ti yuttapattakālaṃ ñatvāva parammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya.
Abhinivissa voharatīti pattanti sañjānanajanapadaṃ gantvā “pattaṃ āharatha dhovathā”ti sutvā “andhabālaputhujjano, nayidaṃ pattaṃ, pāti namesā, evaṃ vadāhī”ti abhinivissa voharati.
Tathā tathā voharati aparāmasanti amhākaṃ janapade bhājanaṃ pātīti vuccati, ime pana naṃ pattanti vadantīti tato paṭṭhāya janapadavohāraṃ muñcitvā pattaṃ pattanteva aparāmasanto voharati.
Subhūti ca pana, bhikkhaveti ayaṃ thero dvīsu ṭhānesu etadaggaṃ āruḷho “araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti, dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ yadidaṃ subhūtī”ti (a. ni.1.202).
Anurodhena vinā sampahaṃsanavasena yathābhūtaguṇakathanaṃ nevussādanā vajjābhāvato;
tathā virodhena vinā vivecanavasena yathābhūtadosakathanaṃ na apasādanaṃ.
Sabhāvamevāti yathābhūtasabhāvameva kassaci puggalassa anādesakaraṇavasena katheyya, seyyathāpi āyasmā subhūtitthero.
Parammukhā avaṇṇanti svāyaṃ rahovādo pesuññūpasaṃhāravasena pavatto idhādhippetoti āha “pisuṇavācanti attho”ti.
Khīṇātīti khīṇo, yo bhāsati, yañca uddissa bhāsati, dvepi hiṃsati vibādhatīti attho, taṃ khīṇavādaṃ.
Svāyaṃ yasmā kilesehi ākiṇṇo saṃkiliṭṭho eva ca hoti, tasmā vuttaṃ –
Tathā sapariḷāhoti vipākapariḷāhena ceva kilesapariḷāhena ca sapariḷāho.
Vaṭṭato nissarituṃ adatvā tattheva sīdāpanato micchāpaṭipadābhāvena satte saṃyojetīti saṃyojanaṃ, visesato bhavasaṃyojanaṃ taṇhāti āha “taṇhāyetaṃ nāman”ti.
Na taṇhāyeva mānādayopi saṃyojanattaṃ sādhenti nāma sabbaso saṃyojanato suṭṭhu bandhanato.
Imaṃ catukkanti,“ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā, ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā”ti evamāgataṃ imaṃ catukkaṃ nissāya.
“Etadagge ṭhapito”ti, vatvā taṃ nissāya ṭhapitabhāvaṃ vitthārato dassetuṃ,“bhagavato hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Ayaṃ puggalo … pe … ācārasampannoti vā natthi paresaṃ anuddesakavasena dhammadesanāya pavattanato.
Na hi kadāci nindiyo pasaṃsiyo hoti, taṃ pana kālaṃ ñatvāva kathetabbanti āha,“yuttapattakālaṃ ñatvāvā”ti.
Abhinivissa voharatīti evametaṃ, na ito aññathāti taṃ janapadaniruttiṃ abhinivisitvā samudācarati.
Atidhāvananti samaññaṃ nāmetaṃ lokasaṅketasiddhā paññattīti paññattimatte aṭṭhatvā paramatthato thāmasā parāmassa voharaṇaṃ.
Raṇanti sattā etehi kandanti akandantāpi kandanakāraṇabhāvatoti raṇā;
rāgadosamohā, dasapi vā kilesā, sabbepi vā ekantākusalā, tehi nānappakāradukkhanibbattakehi abhibhūtā sattā kandanti;
Pāḷiyaṃ pana “sadukkho eso dhammo”tiādinā āgatattā kāmasukhānuyogādayopi “saraṇo”ti vuttāti dukkhādīnaṃ raṇabhāvo tannibbattakasabhāvānaṃ akusalānaṃ saraṇatā ca veditabbā.
